rows.note: Use this as the everyday default for the recreational activity of fishing with a rod or line.

example.english: I like going fishing by the sea whenever I have time.
example.traditional: 我得閒就鍾意去海邊釣魚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak1 haan4 zau6 zung1 ji3 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 diu3 jyu4

rows.note: Use this formal term when referring generally to the activity of catching fish rather than recreational angling.

example.english: Fishing activities have a certain impact on marine ecology.
example.traditional: 漁撈活動對海洋生態有一定影響。
example.jyutping: jyu4 lou4 wut6 dung6 deoi3 hoi2 joeng4 sang1 taai3 jau5 jat1 ding6 jing2 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this for fishing as a commercial industry or business.

example.english: Many people in this village make a living from fishing.
example.traditional: 呢條村好多人靠漁業維生。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 cyun1 hou2 do1 jan4 kaau3 jyu4 jip6 wai4 sang1
